title: Products of co-sober spaces need not be co-sober
summary: We answer negatively the question whether the product of two co-sober spaces must be co-sober. For a nonempty closed subset $A$ of a $T_1$-space $(X,τ)$, we consider the topology consisting of the co-finite open sets together with the $τ$-open sets disjoint from $A$. We determine its $k$-irreducible compact subsets and derive a criterion that produces two compact co-sober spaces whose product contains a non-singleton $k$-irreducible compact saturated subset of the diagonal. Applying the criterion to a specific Kovář--van Douwen space gives two countable compact Fréchet--Urysohn $T_1$…
